summary: vmware.vmware_rest requires ansible-core 2.16+, and vcenter_vm_guest_filesystem_directories now errors when the API request fails instead of reporting unchanged.
questions: Why does vcenter_vm_guest_filesystem_directories fail when the directory exists?

answer_card.title: vmware_rest major changes in Ansible 15
answer_card.answer_md:
- Minimum **ansible-core 2.16** in `meta/runtime.yml`.
- `vcenter_vm_guest_filesystem_directories` now **raises an error** when the vSphere API request fails (for example creating an existing directory) instead of returning success/unchanged. Handle the failure explicitly if needed.
